prompts.armor: One isolated modular ARMOR PLATE component for GenVo's near-vertical top-down native32 pixel-art creature game. True transparent background, no scene or whole animal, no head, legs, tail, eye, lettering, UI, glow or cast shadow. Direct overhead low-relief view, horizontal axis points right. A compact broad asymmetrical shield of three interlocking organic osteoderm scutes, gently curved living sage-jade skin around darker recessed seams. NOT a faceted gemstone or metal shield. Three broad sculpted plates with slightly chipped growth ridges and small restrained pale CYAN mineral edge highlights on hardened ridges, visually distinct from cool green living skin; no ivory horns or spikes. Centre attachment area opaque continuous tissue. Crisp cohesive pixel clusters, 5 broad green value groups, one cyan accent material, no tiny speckled noise. Shape designed for about 20x18 native pixels in a transparent32 frame and mounted either on a dorsal socket or mirrored flank sockets. Strong simple silhouette, rounded polygonal organic edges, modest overhead thickness without side-view elevation. Whole component centered with generous transparent margin.
prompts.hide: One isolated modular ARMORED HIDE patch for GenVo's near-vertical top-down native32 pixel-art creature system. True transparent background. No complete animal, limbs, head, tail, face, horns, wings, lettering, UI, glow or cast shadow. A low elongated horizontal flexible strip of three overlapping organic armadillo-like osteoderm plates, long axis points right, viewed directly overhead. Broad dark green living skin joins the plates, staggered irregular rounded scutes taper at both ends, small warm IVORY keratin growth ridges along hardened outer edges. Continuous opaque central attachment patch. Distinct from a broad dorsal shell: this is a narrow layered hide band to sit along a flank and mirror to the other side. Not repeated rectangular roof tiles, not feathers, not a metal object, not a side view. Muted cool sage-jade 5-value skin, warm ivory highlights clearly separated in hue to preserve a protected material mask. Crisp simple pixel-art clusters designed to read at 24x12 pixels inside a transparent32 frame; modest restrained detail, strong organic silhouette, no antialias mist or tiny speckle. Whole component centered with generous transparent margin.
